description: Les plans de mise en accessibilité de la voirie et des espaces publics is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapserveur.application.i2. State of play of accessibility plans for roads and public spaces (PAVE). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Accessibility plans for roads and public spaces" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Réseaux de transport, Cartes interactives. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2012-08-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
